{"objects": [{"x_min": 0, "y_min": 0, "x_max": 0, "y_max": 0}, ...]}

x_min, y_min, x_max and y_max are integers from 0 to 1000 over the whole
photo: x is the horizontal position (0 = left edge, 1000 = right edge) and y

whatever the photo's size, the right edge is x = 1000 and the bottom edge is
y = 1000.

prompt:
Find each red oval in this photo. Draw one box around each one: the smallest rectangle that contains all of its visible part. Leave out any part that is hidden behind something else. Give each object its own box, even when objects touch or overlap; never one box around a group.
Mark every one you can see, however many there are. Do not stop early or give only a sample.

Reply with JSON only, in this shape:
{"objects": [{"x_min": 0, "y_min": 0, "x_max": 0, "y_max": 0}, ...]}
If there are none, reply {"objects": []}.

x_min, y_min, x_max and y_max are integers from 0 to 1000 over the whole
photo: x is the horizontal position (0 = left edge, 1000 = right edge) and y
the vertical position (0 = top edge, 1000 = bottom edge). They are not pixels:
whatever the photo's size, the right edge is x = 1000 and the bottom edge is
y = 1000.
